overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by taking unanimous votes without roll call while a member participated remotely; the Board pledged future roll calls, and the AG issued an advisory rather than a formal order.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board did not take all votes by roll call at a July 14 meeting where one member participated remotely.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law.
